nodes.description: address public owner; the privileged address of Owned/Mortal.
uint256 public cost; wei required per random number request.
uint8 public waitTime; default number of blocks to wait before reveal.
uint256 public max; default upper bound for generated numbers.
mapping(address => PendingNumber) public pendingNumbers; pending/rendered request state per address.
mapping(address => bool) public whiteList; addresses exempt from paying cost.
function owned(); sets owner = msg.sender (initializer).
function transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner; changes the owner.
function kill() onlyOwner; destroys the contract with selfdestruct(owner).
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256); multiplication with assert overflow check.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256); division.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256); subtraction with assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256); addition with assert(c >= a).
function getRandomFromBlockHash(uint blockNumber, uint max) constant; derives a number from block.blockhash.
LuckyNumberService constructor; calls owned() and sets default cost, max and waitTime.
function setMax(uint256) onlyOwner; updates max.
function setWaitTime(uint8) onlyOwner; updates waitTime.
function setCost(uint256) onlyOwner; updates cost.
function enableProxy(address) onlyOwner; whitelists an address.
function removeProxy(address) onlyOwner; deletes an address from whiteList.
function withdraw(address,uint256) onlyOwner; transfers contract balance out.
function () payable; anonymous fallback that forwards to requestNumber.
function requestNumber(address,uint256,uint8) payable; registers a pending random number request.
function revealNumber(address) payable; reveals the random number if authorized.
internal _revealNumber(address); computes and stores the lucky number.
function canReveal(address) constant; view helper returning reveal eligibility data.
internal _canReveal(address,address) constant; authorization check for revealing.
internal _remainingBlocks(address) constant; blocks left before reveal is allowed.
internal _revealBlock(address) constant; block at which the number becomes revealable.
function getNumber(address) constant; returns rendered number, max, origin block and requestor.
function checkNumber(address) constant; true when a request is still pending.
msg.sender; caller address used for ownership, whitelist checks and request indexing.
tx.origin; original transaction sender stored as requestProxy of a pending request.
selfdestruct(owner); permanently destroys the contract.
_recipient.transfer(_balance); external value transfer to an arbitrary address.
block.blockhash(blockNumber); miner-influenced, predictable randomness source.
arithmetic on the hash (sha3(...) % max) and SafeMath add/sub on block numbers.
_newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
blockNumber parameter of getRandomFromBlockHash.
max parameter of getRandomFromBlockHash; used as modulo divisor.
a parameter of SafeMath mul/add.

c local result inside SafeMath mul/add.

_proxy parameter of removeProxy.
_recipient parameter of withdraw.
_balance parameter of withdraw.
_requestor parameter of requestNumber.
_max parameter of requestNumber.
_waitTime parameter of requestNumber.
luckyBlock local in _revealNumber.
luckyNumber local in _revealNumber.
_requestor parameter of revealNumber.
_requestor parameter of canReveal.
revealBlock local in _remainingBlocks.
remainingBlocks local in _remainingBlocks.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner inside owned(), so contract ownership is taken from whatever address initializes it.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with _newOwner, guarded only by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
the _newOwner parameter flows directly into owner, making the parameter the new privileged address.
kill() invokes selfdestruct(owner), an irreversible unsafe operation.
the onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before allowing kill() to run.
withdraw executes _recipient.transfer(_balance), an external value transfer.
the _recipient parameter determines the destination of the transfer.
the _balance parameter determines the amount of the transfer.
withdraw is gated by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender against owner.
getRandomFromBlockHash reads block.blockhash(blockNumber), an untrusted randomness source.
the blockNumber parameter selects which block hash is read.
the block hash result is reduced modulo max and incremented, feeding the arithmetic operation.
the max parameter is used as the modulo divisor; a zero value makes the arithmetic revert.
getRandomFromBlockHash calls SafeMath.add to produce the final number.
operand a flows into the SafeMath arithmetic used by the randomness calculation.
operand b flows into the SafeMath arithmetic used by the randomness calculation.
the arithmetic operation stores its result in the local c.
requestNumber writes a new PendingNumber struct into the pendingNumbers mapping.
the _requestor parameter indexes pendingNumbers when storing or reading the request.
tx.origin is stored as requestProxy, letting the originating address authorize a later reveal.
whiteList is indexed by msg.sender to decide whether the caller is exempt from paying cost.
requestNumber compares msg.value against the cost state variable.
requestNumber reads the default max when initializing the pending request.
requestNumber reads the default waitTime when initializing the pending request.
the _max parameter overrides the pending request max when greater than one.
the _waitTime parameter overrides the pending request waitTime when within bounds.
the payable fallback forwards plain value transfers into requestNumber.
an incoming call from msg.sender enters the payable fallback, which re-enters requestNumber logic.
setMax writes the owner-supplied value into the max state variable.
the _max parameter is assigned to the max state variable.
setWaitTime writes the owner-supplied value into the waitTime state variable.
the _waitTime parameter is assigned to the waitTime state variable.
setCost writes the owner-supplied value into the cost state variable.
the _cost parameter is assigned to the cost state variable.
enableProxy marks an address as true in the whiteList mapping.
the _proxy parameter becomes the key set in whiteList.
removeProxy deletes an address from the whiteList mapping.
the _proxy parameter becomes the key deleted from whiteList.
revealNumber delegates the actual computation to the internal _revealNumber.
revealNumber asserts _canReveal before generating the number, gating who may reveal.
the _requestor parameter is passed from revealNumber into _revealNumber.
_canReveal calls checkNumber to verify a pending request exists.
checkNumber reads renderedNumber and waitTime from the pendingNumbers mapping.
_revealNumber obtains the random value from getRandomFromBlockHash.
the luckyBlock local is used as the blockNumber argument of getRandomFromBlockHash.
_revealNumber writes renderedNumber and zeroes waitTime in pendingNumbers.
the luckyNumber local is stored as the renderedNumber of the pending request.
_remainingBlocks reads waitTime to compute the reveal block of the request.
_remainingBlocks uses SafeMath.add to compute the reveal block.
_remainingBlocks uses SafeMath.sub on block-number arithmetic.
the revealBlock local is the operand of the SafeMath subtraction.
the remainingBlocks local is the value returned by _remainingBlocks.
_revealBlock uses SafeMath.add of originBlock and waitTime.
canReveal calls _canReveal to report authorization status.
the _requestor parameter of canReveal is passed through to the returned tuple and checks.
getNumber reads renderedNumber, max and originBlock from pendingNumbers.
the constructor calls owned() to initialize the owner.
the constructor assigns the default cost value.
the constructor assigns the default max value.
the constructor assigns the default waitTime value.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is a disposable parameter only meaningful as the input of transferOwnership.
blockNumber only selects the block hashed inside getRandomFromBlockHash.
the max argument only modulates the modulo inside getRandomFromBlockHash.
operand a exists only to be consumed by the SafeMath arithmetic helper.
operand b exists only to be consumed by the SafeMath arithmetic helper.
c is a transient result local of the SafeMath arithmetic helper.
_max is the single input argument of setMax and has no independent meaning.
_waitTime is the single input argument of setWaitTime.
_cost is the single input argument of setCost.
_proxy is only used as the whiteList key inside enableProxy.
_proxy is only used as the whiteList key inside removeProxy.
_recipient feeds directly into the external transfer call in withdraw.
_balance feeds directly into the external transfer call in withdraw.
_requestor only indexes pendingNumbers within requestNumber.
_max only overrides the pending request max inside requestNumber.
_waitTime only overrides the pending request waitTime inside requestNumber.
luckyBlock is a temporary value computed inside _revealNumber.
luckyNumber is a temporary value computed and stored inside _revealNumber.
_requestor is the sole argument that revealNumber forwards to _revealNumber.
_requestor is only used inside the read-only canReveal view.
revealBlock is a temporary arithmetic value inside _remainingBlocks.
remainingBlocks is the transient return value of _remainingBlocks.
